method: One replay per compressed file; in-memory library calls; full .slp reconstruction; verification outside timers.

toolchain.cxx_optimization: -O3; C++20 for Slippack, C++17 for slippc; no fast-math

coverage_notes.slippc: 22 files newer than its advertised 3.12.0 limit were not submitted to its fixed-layout transforms.
coverage_notes.peppi: 74 reconstructions panicked at gecko_codes_size (ser.rs:394); 18 reconstructed files differed from source bytes. All three Peppi storage variants had the same failures.
coverage_notes.inputs: 120 distinct SHA-256 hashes; 40 deterministic filename-hash samples from each existing study set. All sets have been examined in prior development.
